name: Indra OCR
description: Fast CPU-only OCR for images and PDFs (printed text, handwriting, 80+ languages, any page angle) with layout-aware output. NOTE: licence is NOT open source license!

ocr_markdown.name: Image to Markdown
ocr_markdown.description: Recognise text and page layout (headings, lists, tables) and write it as Markdown

mode.name: PDF text source
mode.help: For PDFs: use the embedded text layer where it is reliable and OCR the rest (automatic), always OCR every page, or only use the embedded text. Images are always OCRed.

math.name: Math as LaTeX
math.help: Write formulas as LaTeX. Slower on pages with math.

keep_furniture.name: Keep page headers and footers
keep_furniture.help: Keep running headers, footers and page numbers in the Markdown.

max_pages.name: Max pages
max_pages.help: Read at most this many pages of a PDF. 0 reads all pages.

ocr_text.name: Image to text
ocr_text.description: Recognise text and write it as plain text, one line per detected line in reading order

mode.name: PDF text source
mode.help: For PDFs: use the embedded text layer where it is reliable and OCR the rest (automatic), always OCR every page, or only use the embedded text. Images are always OCRed.

max_pages.name: Max pages
max_pages.help: Read at most this many pages of a PDF. 0 reads all pages.

ocr_json.description: Recognise text and write lines, bounding boxes, layout blocks and confidences as JSON
